- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The price difference between natural and synthetic emulsifiers can vary widely depending on the specific emulsifiers being compared and the quantity being purchased.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Natural emulsifiers tend to be more expensive than synthetic emulsifiers due to the higher cost of production and sourcing of raw materials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Example prices for natural emulsifiers include: Lecithin: $10-15 per pound, Beeswax: $10-20 per pound, Plant waxes (e.g. Carnauba wax, Candelilla wax): $20-30 per pound, Plant-based gums (e.g. Xanthan gum, Guar gum): $15-25 per pound, Vegetable-based surfactants (e.g. Sodium lauryl sulfate from coconut oil): $20-30 per pound.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Example prices for synthetic emulsifiers include: Polysorbate 20: $5-10 per pound, Polysorbate 60: $5-10 per pound, Glyceryl stearate: $5-10 per pound, Cetearyl alcohol: $5-10 per pound, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil: $5-10 per pound.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These prices are approximate and may vary depending on the supplier and the quantity being purchased.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The critical-to-quality (CTQ) parameters for toothpaste ingredients may include: Abrasiveness, Fluoride content, Foaming, Flavor, pH, Viscosity, Packaging compatibility.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The viscosity of a 10% solution of Polysorbate 20 at room temperature is typically in the range of 150-300 centipoise (cP).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The viscosity of 10% Polysorbate 60 at room temperature is around 500 to 1,000 centipoise (cP).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] At 10% concentration and room temperature, the viscosity of Ceteareth-20 can range from approximately 7000 to 10000 centipoise (cP).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The viscosity of 10% Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate at room temperature might be in the range of 500-1000 cP (centipoise).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The viscosity of 10% Cetyl PEG/PPG-10/1-Dimethicone at room temperature may vary, and specific values were not provided.
